title: Opening an effect brings it into view
goal: In a short window, opening an effect can leave it half below the bottom of the properties panel, and nothing scrolls to it: you press the chevron, the settings appear somewhere you cannot see, and you have to go looking. Opening an effect should bring that effect on screen.
notes:
Observed 2026-09-08 while finishing one-open-effect-fits-in-the-effects-list. Command: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/effects-fit-one-open-walk.json (window 1280x600). At stage 4-first-folded the log reads dockViewport 568 with dockSections ["Layers 6-169","Appearance 169-334","Effects 334-617","Position & Size 617-752"] and dockInView ["Layers","Appearance"]: the Shadow that was just opened runs 49pt past the bottom of the dock and the dock did not scroll. Capture: queue/audits/2026-09-08-effects-one-open-4.png.

This is the dock reveal (DockRevealScratch / revealSection in Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift) not being asked for by the fold control in Sources/Photonz/EffectsListInspector.swift. UX-PATTERNS Reveal rules apply: shortest move that puts the group on screen, nothing already visible may twitch, and only a command the user just issued may scroll. Opening an effect IS such a command.
acceptance: With the panel too full to hold everything, pressing an effect chevron open scrolls the panel so that effect is fully on screen
A panel that already shows the effect whole does not move at all
Folding an effect away never scrolls anything
A playtest walk proves the opened effect is fully in view afterwards
